prior_exposure: Prior SMV6 native anatomy and research outcomes already exposed; no blind-validation claim. Candidate accounts not yet run.
baseline: CURRENT_LOCAL_SOURCE_GENERATED; authoritative full standalone 779 events / 3260 days verified by sealed metadata, authorized prefix only replayed

candidates.exact_definition: current_pnl <= -1 * atr_entry_frac; 20-day mean true range from 21 completed pre-entry sessions
mfe_sofar >= 0.05 AND current_pnl <= 0; NOT a new trailing percent

trigger_information_time: Completed valid daily OHLC at 16:00; never same-day execution; state_v2.policy_mask called directly
price_semantics: Registered pre_adj OHLC relative to actual first fill entry price, same coordinate as local SMV6; ATR direct state_v2.entry_atr on 21 consecutive valid pre-entry sessions; no threshold fills
earliest_legal_execution_time: Next session OPEN_BAR_09_30 completed close reference used by frozen local execution, not literal auction guarantee. Strictly after trigger, entry T+1. Latched retry. Native earlier exit wins; native simultaneous open sell wins attribution.
gap_through: Actual executable minute reference times (1-0.0008), never threshold price
transaction_cost: Frozen 2bp commission plus 8bp per side slippage, lot100, 50% minute volume cap. Combined native and overlay orders cannot consume same minute cap twice.
instrument_constraints: Conservative T+1 for incremental exits; no new instrument assumptions; existing native execution unchanged. Availability and finite positive minute price/volume mandatory.
reentry_semantics: Original callbacks and membership continue. Pending risk exit suppresses conflicting same-open target buys for that symbol only, including after liquidation; next session original entry may buy same ETF; no cooldown or cash transfer. Native buys of other symbols keep frozen ordering.
missing_handling: Invalid completed day produces no new trigger; missing entry ATR disables ATR for episode. Existing latched exit remains pending. Missing fill availability cannot execute.
selection_policy: No new thresholds. Compare all four in standalone, retain at most one for portfolio if account tail tradeoff is defensible; prioritize MDD/CVaR/month/quarter, portfolio tail then CAGR cost. Historical judgment, no independence or significance claims.
